% a note macro of the usual shape: a skip, then one paragraph-level group with declarations
\newcommand{\remark}[1]{%
    \par\medskip
    {\raggedright\footnotesize\textit{Remark.} #1\par}%
}
% a macro that is not a note (no paragraph-level group)
\newcommand{\strong}[1]{\textbf{#1}}
